summary: Implemented formatDuration in the existing ES module with strict validation and exact integer decomposition. Added 40 independent local behavior tests. All 40 failed against the original stub (development-baseline.log) and all 40 passed after implementation using node --test test/duration.test.mjs; runner evidence is collected after this final source snapshot.

changes.description: Preserves the existing export. Non-number arguments throw TypeError; non-integer/non-finite/negative Numbers throw RangeError. Valid represented integers, including -0 and Number.MAX_VALUE, produce decimal hours with two-digit minimum and two-digit minutes/seconds. BigInt arithmetic is internal only.

Adds 18 literal formatting fixtures, 13 non-number rejection cases, and nine invalid-number rejection cases using node:test and strict assertions. Tests use fixed expected strings and exact error classes, with no package install, network, or external side effects.

rollback.procedure: For this isolated local trial only, restore src/duration.mjs to its recorded baseline contents: export function formatDuration(seconds) { throw new Error("Not implemented"); }. Remove the newly added test/duration.test.mjs if abandoning the feature. Preserve the run records and collected evidence. This restores the intentionally unimplemented starter, not a functional release; rerun status afterward because the source snapshot and existing evidence will become stale. No deployment or data recovery action exists.
